turns.replyTail: an I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?Agent saidYes, you can cancel an order after placing it, but there’s a time window! If it’s been longer or some items are already being fulfilled, you might be able to cancel just the unshipped items.If you want to check your order’s eligibility, just share your order number or confirmation number and I’ll take a look!
